name: AI incidents & governance
summary: Lawsuits over AI-generated sexual deepfakes mount against xAI; AI deepfake ads spread in US midterms
state: Baltimore and several individuals have sued xAI over sexualised deepfake images generated by its Grok chatbot (HarrisMartin; Law360). AI deepfake ads have become more common in US midterm campaigns. No AI-enabled attack on critical infrastructure or AI-attributed mass harm had been reported as of 7 Nov.
